│ - We want to reach a point \((d, 0)\).                                                                                                                                            │
│ - Each jump has length \(l\).                                                                                                                                                     │
│ - Jumps can be made in any direction, not just along the x-axis.                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│ We are asked for the minimum number of moves (jumps) of length \(l\) to reach \((d, 0)\).                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│ ---                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│ Example call: `min_Jumps(2, 1)`                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│ This means:                                                                                                                                                                       │
│ - \(d = 2\)                                                                                                                                                                       │
│ - \(l = 1\)                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│ ---                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│ Step 1: Check if \(d\) is zero.                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│ - If \(d=0\), no jumps needed. Not the case here.                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│ Step 2: Check if \(l = d\).                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│ - If \(l = d\), then one jump directly along the x-axis reaches \((d, 0)\).                                                                                                       │
│ - Here, \(l = 1\), \(d = 2\), so no.                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│ Step 3: Check if \(l > d\).                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│ - If \(l > d\), can we reach \((d, 0)\) in one jump?                                                                                                                              │
│ - Because jumps can be made in any direction, if \(l > d\), one jump can overshoot \(d\) but not land exactly on \((d, 0)\) unless \(d=0\).                                       │
│ - So no, one jump insufficient here.                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│ Step 4: Check if \(d\) is multiple of \(l\).                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│ - If \(d\) is a multiple of \(l\), then jumping exactly along the x-axis \(d/l\) times reaches \((d, 0)\).                                                                        │
│ - Here, \(d=2\), \(l=1\), so \(d/l=2\).                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│ Step 5: Consider the possibility of fewer jumps by jumping in other directions.                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│ - For two jumps of length 1, can we reach \((2, 0)\)?                                                                                                                             │
│ - Yes, by jumping 1 unit along x, then another 1 unit along x.                                                                                                                    │
│ - So 2 jumps work.                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│ - Can we reach \((2, 0)\) in 1 jump of length 1?                                                                                                                                  │
│ - No, because the jump length is 1 but the distance to \((2, 0)\) is 2.                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│ Therefore, the minimum number of jumps is 2.                                                                                                                                      │

│ ```python                                                                                                                                                                         │
│ from typing import List                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│ def parse_nested_parens(paren_string: str) -> List:                                                                                                                               │
│     groups = paren_string.split()                                                                                                                                                 │
│     result = []                                                                                                                                                                   │
│     for group in groups:                                                                                                                                                          │
│         max_depth = 0                                                                                                                                                             │
│         current_depth = 0                                                                                                                                                         │
│         for ch in group:                                                                                                                                                          │
│             if ch == '(':                                                                                                                                                         │
│                 current_depth += 1                                                                                                                                                │
│                 if current_depth > max_depth:                                                                                                                                     │
│                     max_depth = current_depth                                                                                                                                     │
│             elif ch == ')':                                                                                                                                                       │
│                 current_depth -= 1                                                                                                                                                │
│         result.append(max_depth)                                                                                                                                                  │
│     return result                                                                                                                                                                 │
│ ```                                                                                                                                                                               │
